transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because since they made me the acting workflow lead, I’ve been really tense going into the warehouse. I snap at little SAP errors, I’m missing cycle-count deadlines I never used to miss, and by the time I get home I’m too drained to play basketball or work on my sketches.
Do you feel this tension mostly when it has to do with work?

Yeah, mostly work. Ever since I became the acting workflow lead, I’m tense before I even walk into the warehouse. Little SAP errors set me off, and I’ve been missing cycle-count deadlines I normally wouldn’t. Then I get home wiped out and don’t have much left for basketball or sketching.
If the acting workflow lead role were no longer on your plate, do you think most of this tension would go away?

Yeah, I think so. It really started when I took on that acting lead role. I’m already wound up walking into the warehouse, and then every little SAP issue gets under my skin. If that pressure wasn’t on me, I don’t think I’d be so drained or falling behind on things I used to handle fine.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I’m not really sure I’d call it depressed. I’ve mostly just been stressed and worn out from work.
Outside of work, do you also find yourself worrying a lot about other parts of your life?
Not really. It’s mainly the work stuff that’s been on my mind.
Since this started, have you been feeling down most days?
I’m not sure. I’ve been pretty stressed and tired, but I haven’t really noticed feeling down most days.
Did these problems start within 3 months of becoming the acting workflow lead?
Yeah. The lead role started after the team merger, and within the first month or two I could tell I wasn’t handling work the way I normally do.
Has this stress been hurting your ability to do your job?

Yeah. My supervisor had to talk to me about missing cycle-count deadlines in a performance check-in. And outside of work, I’ve stopped going to basketball and doing my usual sketching because work’s basically taking over all my time.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
I don’t think so. I’ve been overwhelmed, but I haven’t really felt hopeless.
Have you been feeling sad?
I’m not really sure. I’ve mostly just noticed feeling overwhelmed by everything.
Have you lost interest in basketball or sketching?
Not really—I still like them. I just haven’t been going to basketball or making time to sketch because work has been taking over everything.
When worries about work come up, do you find it hard to control or shut them off?
Yeah. Since I became the acting workflow lead, I keep thinking about warehouse stuff—SAP errors, what I’m behind on. I get to work already tense, and it’s hard to really switch it off.
Since this started, have you gotten into any physical fights or done anything that could get you in trouble at work or with the law?
No, I haven’t gotten into any fights or done anything like that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping since this started?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed a real change in my sleep.
Since this started, have you been crying more than usual?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed myself crying more than usual.
Since this started, have you been more irritable than usual?
Yeah, more than usual. Since I became the acting workflow lead, I’ve been going into the warehouse already tense and snapping at little things, like SAP errors.
Do you feel your reaction to the acting workflow lead role has been stronger than most people would have in the same situation?

Yeah, I think so. I didn’t expect it to get to me this much—I'm tense before I even get into the warehouse, and little SAP errors set me off. I’m missing cycle-count deadlines I normally wouldn’t miss, and by the time I get home I’m too drained to do much of anything.
Even when work is not on your mind, do you still feel anxious a lot of the time?
I’m not sure. I mostly notice it around work, honestly.
Do you feel your anxiety about this role is out of proportion to what the job actually requires?
Yeah, probably. I mean, it’s an acting role, but I’m walking in tense every day and getting worked up over little SAP errors. It’s affecting my work and then I’m completely drained once I’m home.
Are you still in the acting workflow lead role right now?
Yeah, I’m still in it. The acting lead responsibilities are still there, so I’m dealing with that change every day.
